reason: The cited evidence (E1) supports the synthesis, spray coating, low friction/wear values, and tribocatalytic mechanism under ambient, high-pressure conditions. However, it provides no data or discussion regarding performance across a wide temperature range, leaving that key premise unsupported.
premises: 2D HEA (MoWNbTaV)0.2S2 can be synthesized and applied via spray coating.
The material exhibits a low coefficient of friction (0.076) and wear rate (10^-9 mm3/Nm) under high contact pressure in ambient conditions.
The low friction and wear are due to shear-induced tribocatalytic activity forming lubricious films.
The layered 2D structure facilitates interlayer gliding and energy dissipation.
The performance is robust across a wide temperature range.
